fallbackDescriptions.Super + Ctrl + S: Open a visible URI from the frozen screens
fallbackDescriptions.Super + Shift + Space: Toggle floating for the focused window
fallbackDescriptions.Super + F: Toggle maximized for the focused window
fallbackDescriptions.Super + Shift + F: Toggle fullscreen for the focused window
fallbackDescriptions.Ctrl + Shift + H: Swap with the window to the left
fallbackDescriptions.Ctrl + Shift + L: Swap with the window to the right
fallbackDescriptions.Ctrl + H: Focus the window to the left
fallbackDescriptions.Ctrl + L: Focus the window to the right
fallbackDescriptions.Super + Tab: Move the workspace to the next monitor
fallbackDescriptions.Super + Shift + Tab: Move the workspace to the previous monitor
fallbackDescriptions.Super + Shift + 1: Move the focused window to workspace 1
fallbackDescriptions.Super + Shift + 2: Move the focused window to workspace 2
fallbackDescriptions.Super + Shift + 3: Move the focused window to workspace 3
fallbackDescriptions.Super + Shift + 4: Move the focused window to workspace 4
fallbackDescriptions.Super + Alt + Shift + 1: Move the focused window to workspace 5
fallbackDescriptions.Super + Alt + Shift + 2: Move the focused window to workspace 6
fallbackDescriptions.Super + Alt + Shift + 3: Move the focused window to workspace 7
fallbackDescriptions.Super + Alt + Shift + 4: Move the focused window to workspace 8
fallbackDescriptions.Super + Ctrl + Shift + 1: Move the focused window to workspace 9
fallbackDescriptions.Super + Ctrl + Shift + 2: Move the focused window to workspace 10
fallbackDescriptions.Super + Ctrl + Shift + 3: Move the focused window to workspace 11
fallbackDescriptions.Super + Ctrl + Shift + 4: Move the focused window to workspace 12
